title: EmoReward: Self-Evolving Reward Calibration for Emotional Video Generation RL
abstract: arXiv:2611.06518v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has advanced generative model post-training in verifiable domains such as code and mathematics, but evaluating video quality, especially emotional expression, often depends on subjective aesthetics and has no uniquely correct target. Existing approaches typically rely on fixed rewards for visual quality, motion quality, and text alignment that poorly capture emotional intent and can invite reward hacking, while RLHF is difficult to scale and subject to individual aesthetic differences that complicate the calibration of facial, body motion, and chromatic cues across narrative contexts. We introduce EmoReward, a new self-evolving training mechanism that distills evidence reliability from reward traces collected during an actual training run to adaptively guide multi-reward weight allocation in subsequent training by determining which emotional evidence to trust and how much to weight it. translated_title: EmoReward：面向情感视频生成强化学习的自进化奖励校准
translated_abstract: 组相对策略优化（GRPO）已在代码和数学等可验证领域推动了生成模型的后训练，但视频质量（尤其是情感表达）的评估往往依赖于主观美学，缺乏唯一正确的目标。现有方法通常依赖针对视觉质量、运动质量和文本对齐的固定奖励，这些奖励难以捕捉情感意图，并可能引发奖励作弊；而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）难以扩展，且受个体审美差异影响，使得在不同叙事情境下校准面部、肢体动作和色彩线索变得复杂。我们提出了 EmoReward，一种全新的自进化训练机制，它从实际训练过程中收集的奖励轨迹中提炼证据可靠性，通过判定哪些情感证据可信以及应赋予多大权重，自适应地引导后续训练中的多奖励权重分配。
tldr: EmoReward 提出一种自进化奖励校准机制，通过从训练过程的奖励轨迹中提炼证据可靠性来自适应调整多奖励权重分配，解决了固定奖励难以捕捉情感意图且易引发奖励作弊的问题。
en_tdlr: EmoReward introduces a self-evolving reward calibration mechanism that distills evidence reliability from reward traces to adaptively guide multi-reward weight allocation, overcoming the limitations of fixed rewards that poorly capture emotional intent and invite reward hacking in emotional video generation RL.
